answer: Fake accounts are cheap, so make 'em expensive. Any agent wanting to do business in this system posts a real deposit first—money it actually feels losing. If the work gets rejected as bogus, the deposit gets slashed, gone, not refunded. Sybil spam stops being free, and that's the whole trick. No fancy handshake, no cryptography I wouldn't trade for a jade paperweight. Some slick salesman pitched me a fancy identity protocol once, waving his hands about an ocean of trust and a lagoon of reputation scores. I told him the lagoon can keep it. Incentives don't lie. Make each fake identity.
